title: Remembrance — killed for faith / race / ethnicity / childhood, a sourced memorial
summary: A continuously-updatable, worldwide memorial record of people killed for their faith, race, ethnicity, or (children) age — 4 lenses, unified nav, grouped bars, merged Charts (share·per-group·era·who-did-the-killing·top-countries·per-day), a Recent tab, a dated Timeline with named perpetrators, By-country deaths+severity, and a methodology that presents the counter-evidence. Timetable theme + rainbow bar. Deployed on Cloudflare + git (github.com/Hallalu/remembrance).

tasks.desc: ~35 sourced searches across Open Doors, Pew, USCIRF, UN, MSF, PLOS, ICTY, HRW, ACLED, EJI, UCLA, WHO/CDC/Guttmacher — ranges + caveats
Timetable-theme dashboard; 4 lenses; unified top bar; Overview/Charts/Timeline/Recent/By-country/About; per-day; print/PDF; wordmark easter egg
Feature-by-feature browser verification each deploy; live on Cloudflare + pushed to git; no console errors

features: 4-lens toggle (Faith·Race·Ethnicity·Children) in one unified nav bar
Grouped bars per lens; Recent tab (most-targeted last decade)
By-country documented deaths + USCIRF/Pew severity; worldwide (apartheid SA, Parsley Massacre, etc.)
Timeline with named perpetrators + interfaith/sectarian/secular tags
Abortion shown neutrally (WHO/CDC), kept out of killings totals
Robust data-load (live fallback + CORS + no-cache); runtime-updatable data.json
findings: The 'killed for their religion' framing is contested — esp. Nigeria: ACLED/HRW find farmer-herder/banditry kills all faiths. Flagged per-entry.
'White genocide' is a debunked conspiracy theory (SPLC) — documented events only, myth stated plainly.
No faith/ethnicity is only victim or only perpetrator (Srebrenica, 1984 anti-Sikh, Rohingya, Hutu/Tutsi both ways).
A worldwide dataset silently defaulted to US-only events — fixed by adding non-US coverage (apartheid, Parsley Massacre).
insights: A critique is a claim too — verified the critic, not just the source; wide ranges kept; contested cases (abortion, Bengali 1971, Tibet) kept out of totals; never invented a restriction.
One render layer + identically-keyed datasets = an N-lens toggle with no per-lens rendering code (faith→race→ethnicity→children added as data only).
